intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Waves and Light — light basics, reflection and plane mirrors, concave and convex mirrors, refraction and the index of refraction, Snell's law and total internal reflection, and dispersion and diffraction. It is **generated fresh every time you open it**: a new set of questions drawn from across the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled.

The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`). BASIS Physics 8 is a pre-AP course, so this is geometric optics (ray diagrams, $n = c/v$, Snell's law solved for an index, $\sin\theta_c = 1/n$) held to AP Physics 2 rigor; no lens/mirror equation or wave-interference maths.

**No calculator.** Every multiple-choice item is built to be solved by hand (round numbers, standard angles, given sine values). Multiple choice is scored automatically; free response is scored by you against the model answer and rubric.

The bank is tranche 1; drawn-ray-diagram items will follow.
